claims.review: 20261005 physical matrix/type review: Compared all four active vectors and weights 3,4,5,6. The kernel connects every vector to its actual q=m=2 paper-table row.

20261005 physical matrix/type review: The entire two-row align includes both W2 and W3. Compared both columns in the ordered two-qubit basis 00,01,10,11, including the negative sin(theta/2) entry in W3. Both actual matrices are isometries.

20261005 physical matrix/type review: The entire align includes both image-projector and intertwining identities for W2 and W3. All four equalities use the actual matrices and literal ZI/XX or IZ/ZX tensor factors, for every real theta.

20261005 physical matrix/type review: Replaced the earlier normalization-only binding with the complete actual 64-by-2 encoder bridge. Arbitrary real a,b with 2*a^2+b^2=1/4 give an isometry, and every actual six-qubit tensor Pauli of weight at most two has scalar compression. The code projector and its actual six-Y conjugate spin flip are orthogonal. Zero coefficients are allowed. The separate A2 formula is not inferred from KL or spin flip alone.
20261005 physical matrix/type review: Compared the literal physical words Z1 Z5 Z6 and X2 X3 X4 X5 X6. The actual cat action has signs +,+,+,-,-; SX fixes both code columns.

20261005 physical matrix/type review: Actual physical L3 times the encoder equals the encoder times diag(-1,+1), with the printed logical-color order. This is an operator action on both columns, not only an expectation value.

20261005 physical matrix/type review: The exact physical product L3*SX is minus Z1 X2 X3 X4 Y5 Y6. Its weight is six and its action on the actual code is the same diag(-1,+1). The Gaussian multiplication phase is retained.
